name: Headroom
description: Compresses tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, files, and history locally before they reach the model, as a Python or TypeScript library, a drop-in proxy, an agent wrapper, or an MCP server.

skills.name: Inline Compression
skills.description: Compresses a message list in Python or TypeScript with compress(), routing JSON, source code, and prose to a matching compressor.

skills.name: Compression Proxy
skills.description: Runs headroom proxy as a local drop-in endpoint that compresses traffic to Anthropic, OpenAI, or Bedrock with no application code changes.

skills.name: Agent Wrapping
skills.description: Launches Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider, and other agents routed through Headroom with headroom wrap, and undoes it with unwrap.

skills.name: Reversible Retrieval
skills.description: Caches originals locally so the model can call headroom_retrieve over MCP when it needs the full text behind a compressed chunk.

skills.name: Session Learning
skills.description: Mines failed sessions with headroom learn and writes corrections to CLAUDE.local.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or another agent file.
